svg.title: My GitHub numbers
svg.desc: 3,336 contributions (in the past 6 months, on 123 days). 39 days commit streak (my longest ever). 2,802 commits in 35 repos (22 of them private). 14,238 contributions since 2013 (on 1,937 different days)
